SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM plants

SELECT plants.id, plants.common_name, plants.scientific_name, plants.category, plants.planting_place, plants.icon_url, plants.image_url, plants.taxon_id, taxons.name AS taxon_name, plants.created_at 
FROM plants LEFT OUTER JOIN taxons ON plants.taxon_id = taxons.id ORDER BY plants.created_at DESC 
 LIMIT $1::INTEGER OFFSET $2::INTEGER

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM projects

SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.client_name, projects.location, projects.description, projects.created_at, projects.updated_at, (SELECT count(projectplants.plant_id) AS count_1 
FROM projectplants 
WHERE projectplants.project_id = projects.id) AS plant_count 
FROM projects ORDER BY projects.updated_at DESC 
 LIMIT $1::INTEGER OFFSET $2::INTEGER

SELECT (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM plants) AS total_plants, (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM taxons) AS total_taxonomy_nodes, (SELECT count(*) AS count_3 
FROM categories) AS total_categories, (SELECT count(*) AS count_4 
FROM projects) AS total_projects

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM categories

SELECT categories.id, categories.name, categories.description, count(plants.id) AS count_1 
FROM categories LEFT OUTER JOIN plants ON categories.name = plants.category GROUP BY categories.id, categories.name, categories.description ORDER BY categories.name 
 LIMIT $1::INTEGER OFFSET $2::INTEGER
